## Review: FAFF-7001

### Phase 1: standard review (faffter-noon-review)

Signal: pass. No findings.

## Adversarial findings

---

NEEDS HUMAN (malformed backend configuration)

`faff adversarial-backends --consumer code_review` exited 2: `adversarial.fallbacks is not valid JSON: Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 (line 1 column 2)`. The review helper was not invoked and there was no fallback to the primary reviewer alone. No adversarial opinion was obtained.

### major: Malformed adversarial.fallbacks configuration

Location: .faffrc.yaml
The `adversarial.fallbacks` value cannot be parsed as JSON, so the adversarial backend chain cannot be resolved.
Action: Correct the JSON in adversarial.fallbacks in .faffrc.yaml and re-run the review.
